shows: minimap (3-D, rotates with camera, revealed tiles, boss heads & quest givers)

land-caption.desc: land name fades in on entering (2012-07)

combo-counter.desc: near cursor; blue with '!' at cap

crosshair.desc: no target lock; ../domain/controls.dsl (locator=look) adds no lock-on

enemy-names.desc: colour by relative power (A) / tier (S) + optional stars; friendly = light blue + wave; other players' level on highlight (0.9.3-0)

debug-menu.design: D17: Godot Debug Menu add-on, ../domain/controls.dsl (locator=debug-menu) cycles hidden/compact/full, kept in release exports so any player can profile

world-map.desc: 3-D voxel map, rotate/zoom (1:4..1:256 S); near zoom = terrain miniature (structures visible as voxels + names), far = landmarks; players as heads, missions as icons, markers, shrines as blue dots, flight points as +; A: unexplored uniform blue per land, explored trail lighter; S: full colours everywhere, white flashing current land border, land selector arrows, coordinates; current menu time/input boundaries: ../domain/controls.dsl (locator=contract)

overview-map.desc: schematic lands + levels (blue ocean, green own level, red higher, grey lower)

extras: S weapon/armor star rating at left

skills.desc: skill tree, 2 points/level; hybrid (D20): the class/spec tree as a list, activate = spend one banked point

npc-service.desc: hybrid (D22): interact within design.settlement.npc.interact-radius of an NPC: vendors open a two-list shop (stock / bag; buy-item / sell-item; ui-cancel closes), trainer respecs, innkeeper rests — both as a HUD toast; meanings: ../domain/controls.dsl (locator=interact)

quick-select.desc: selector of potions/food/bombs; quick-cycle changes selection; count shown; ../domain/controls.dsl (locator=quick-select)

customization-bench.desc: bench-rotate changes model view; bench-place attaches cubes; bench-remove destroys them; ../domain/controls.dsl (locator=bench-rotate)

character-creation.desc: race, gender, class, head, hair, hair colour, name; random background (A)

world-selection.desc: character select → world select → seed entry

system-menu.desc: system menu and help entry; ../domain/controls.dsl (locator=menu); physical defaults and current cursor-only approximation belong to profiles

item-tooltip.desc: name (rarity colour) + material + type + +N (A); stats; sell price (A, removed 0.9.1-4); red name = wrong class; stars per rarity display option

camera.mode: third person, camera zoom (../domain/controls.dsl (locator=zoom)); full zoom-in = first person (kept, D9)
